title: How Vaccines Work: Training Your Immune System
description: A vaccine shows your immune system a harmless copy of a germ. Learn how this training lets your body fight the real thing fast.

beats.narration: What if your body could practice fighting a disease before ever catching it? That is exactly what a vaccine does.

props.text: Practice fighting a disease before catching it

beats.narration: A vaccine contains a weakened or killed germ, or just a piece of it. It looks like a threat, but it cannot make you seriously ill.
Your immune system learns to recognize it and destroy it. Next time the real germ shows up, your body is ready.

props.text: Next time, your body is ready.
